title: Respected business leader receives downloads

tellings.quote: like one of the individuals that that was brought to me was was highly credible that that does receive what he describes as downloads.

plain: A highly credible person brought to a congressman's attention says he receives what he calls downloads, knowledge that seems to arrive in his mind from outside. The congressman, Eric Burlison, tells Michels he was introduced to this man himself, and describes him as a respected figure. If true, it would suggest some kind of outside contact reaching even serious, accomplished people.
